name: Ahab
contribution: The 7th king of Israel, the son and successor of King Omri, and the husband of Jezebel of Sidon.
legacy: He is depicted in the Hebrew Bible as a Baal worshipper, though some modern scholars question this, and is criticized for causing moral decline in Israel.

checks.lead: Ahab (, AY-habb; Hebrew: אַחְאָב, romanized: ʾAḥʾāḇ; Akkadian: 𒀀𒄩𒀊𒁍, romanized: Aḫâbbu; Koine Greek: Ἀχαάβ, romanized: Akhaáb; Latin: Achab) was the 7th king of Israel, the son and successor of King Omri, and the husband of Jezebel of Sidon. He is depicted in the Hebrew Bible as a Baal worshipper, though some modern scholars question this,  and is criticized for causing moral decline in Israel.
